summary: Clackamas County, OR 50-foot pole lookout built 1930 in Mount Hood NF; abandoned 1960 and gone; site now a viewpoint at the Clackamas Wilderness edge.

facts.design: 50-foot pole tower with an open platform (FFLOS)
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1960; FFLOS and firelookout.com say the lookout is gone

access.note: Oregon Hikers: the road to the top is usually gated lower down and opened for deer hunting season; the site is on the Clackamas Wilderness boundary

visit.trail_note: Oregon Hikers field guide lists the site as a viewpoint; the road to the top is usually gated lower down

notes_for_editor: Excluded a Willhite Lookout Site page with the same name (a 1935 40-foot pole tower, abandoned 1936); its location is Pend Oreille County, Washington, so it is a different lookout. Only one staffing name was found. The brief's 1960 'removed' event is recorded as abandoned. The FFLOS and firelookout.com elevations agree at 4,771 ft. The Oregon Hikers access note is the only current-status source and is a hiking guide, not an agency notice; check before publishing any access advice.
